item.title: Photons for Reach, Atoms for Entanglement: A Compound Photon-Atom Blueprint for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
item.summary: By combining the long-range connectivity of photonic qubits with near-deterministic entanglement mediated by cavity-coupled atoms, Quantum Source’s new blueprint lays out a concrete, quantitative path toward practical fault-tolerant quantum computing. Insider Brief Today’s quantum processors have demonstrated remarkable scientific progress.
